objective: Improve external embedding retrieval through broader directly supervised data
architecture: Keep two layers / width 384 / output 384 for first comparison
loss: multi-positive query-to-passage contrastive loss; no teacher-vector or ranking distillation
hard_negatives: Exclude supplied mined negatives initially; mine and review candidates in a separate phase
sampling: One unique canonical query per source, bounded-buffer streaming shuffle (8192); pinned revisions; not a uniform full-corpus reservoir
validation: Hold connected query/passage groups together; full held-corpus ranking by source and independent-domain development retrieval
acceptance: Existing SciFact/NFCorpus/ArguAna/STSB are observed development tasks; reserve new tests before training
limits: Exact/canonical and model-visible duplicate checks do not establish exhaustive near-duplicate removal; audit source and length balance before training
exclusion_policy: Exclude exact model-visible query/passage identities from observed and reserved benchmark TEXT; relevance judgments not read
long_pair_policy: Retain long pairs in audited source pool; exclude at-cap inputs from first run; extract answer-preserving windows before adding them
local_preflight: six focused tests plus eight-step float and ternary CPU smokes passed; quality unmeasured
authorization_scope: Only the separately approved $1.50 / four-hour data-first job; not standing approval for later jobs
status: completed; retrieval improved; target not yet met; pod deleted
